title: The intro is four beats: the key elements as wireframes, one breach, one ram, the gunship firing
context: Owner, 2026-09-24, after watching the twelve-shot showcase (2026-09-19-showcase-built): 'the intro is not compelling. Let's simplify: A) we introduce the key elements as wireframes; B) we show one breach and the enemies coming out; C) we show one scene of a tank ramming 50 enemies; D) we show a gunship firing on enemies below.'
outcome: Accepted: the showcase's shot table shrinks to four beats in that order — A the key elements revealed as labelled wireframes (the SOL-82 briefing treatment: tank, gunship, SOL-82, a sentry); B one breach opening with the swarm pouring out; C the tank ramming a horde of fifty; D the gunship firing down on the swarm. Then Isao: ARE YOU READY? with PLAY / SKIP TUTORIAL, as now. Each beat long enough to read; the whole shorter than before. The once-only, ?intro=, PLAYTEST-drawer and loading-screen behaviour stay.
alternatives: Keep twelve shots and fix the three that did not land; rejected by the owner: fewer, clearer beats.
